--// SKY HOP V2 YE

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--==================================================
-- CONFIG
--==================================================

local DEFAULT_HEIGHT = 200
local MIN_HEIGHT, MAX_HEIGHT = 50, 500

local DEFAULT_DISTANCE = 75
local MIN_DISTANCE, MAX_DISTANCE = 50, 100

local DEFAULT_INTERVAL = 1
local MIN_INTERVAL, MAX_INTERVAL = 0.25, 5

local ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(85, 145, 255)
local PANEL_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 28)
local PANEL_TRANSPARENCY = 0.08

--==================================================
-- STATE
--==================================================

local height = DEFAULT_HEIGHT
local distance = DEFAULT_DISTANCE
local interval = DEFAULT_INTERVAL
local panelTransparency = PANEL_TRANSPARENCY

local hoverEnabled = false
local sideEnabled = false
local equipEnabled = false
local autoReturnEnabled = false

local character, humanoid, root, backpack
local anchorPosition
local sideDirection = Vector3.xAxis
local sideOffset = 0
local sideSign = 1
local sideTimer = 0
local equipTimer = 0

local activeSlider
local alive = true
local minimized = false
local characterGeneration = 0

--==================================================
-- CHARACTER HELPERS
--==================================================

local function getRoot()
    character = player.Character
    if not character then return false end

    humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")

    return humanoid ~= nil and root ~= nil
end

local function stopMovement()
    hoverEnabled = false
    sideEnabled = false
    anchorPosition = nil
    sideOffset = 0
    sideTimer = 0
end

local function prepareAnchor()
    if not getRoot() then
        return false
    end

    anchorPosition = root.Position

    local look = root.CFrame.RightVector
    sideDirection = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)

    if sideDirection.Magnitude < 0.01 then
        sideDirection = Vector3.xAxis
    else
        sideDirection = sideDirection.Unit
    end

    sideOffset = 0
    sideSign = 1
    sideTimer = 0

    return true
end

--==================================================
-- GUI
--==================================================

local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SkyHopV2YE")
if oldGui then
    oldGui:Destroy()
end

--==================================================
-- UI HELPERS
--==================================================

local function makeLabel(text, parent)
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 24)

    label.TextSize = 12
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = parent or body
    return label
end

local function makeButton(text, parent, color)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 38)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 35, 48)
    button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    button.Text = text
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 240, 255)
    button.TextSize = 12
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    button.AutoButtonColor = true
    button.Parent = parent or body

    Instance.new("UICorner", button).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)

    local outline = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    outline.Color = color or ACCENT
    outline.Transparency = 0.72
    outline.Parent = button

    return button
end

local function makeSlider(labelText, minVal, maxVal, initial, callback)
    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 55)
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.Parent = body

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215, 224, 243)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextSize = 12
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = holder

    local bar = Instance.new("TextButton")
    bar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30)
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
    bar.Text = ""
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 47, 62)
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.AutoButtonColor = false
    bar.Parent = holder

    Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Name = "AccentFill"
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(
        (initial - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal), 0, 1, 0
    )
    fill.Parent = bar

    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
    knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(fill.Size.X.Scale, 0, 0.5, 0)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Parent = bar

    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local value = initial

    local function setFromX(x)
        local width = bar.AbsoluteSize.X
        if width <= 0 then return end

        local alpha = math.clamp(
            (x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / width, 0, 1
        )

        value = minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * alpha
        value = math.floor(value * 100 + 0.5) / 100

        local shown = value
        if maxVal > 5 then
            shown = math.floor(value + 0.5)
        end

        fill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
        label.Text = labelText .. "  •  " .. tostring(shown)

        callback(value)
    end

    label.Text = labelText .. "  •  " .. tostring(initial)

    bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            activeSlider = bar
            setFromX(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if activeSlider == bar and (
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        ) then
            setFromX(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            activeSlider = nil
        end
    end)

    return holder
end

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==================================================

local dragging = false
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPosition

header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = main.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

header.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (
        input == dragInput
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

minimize.Activated:Connect(function()
    minimized = not minimized
    body.Visible = not minimized

    main.Size = minimized
        and UDim2.fromOffset(300, 48)
        or UDim2.fromOffset(300, 440)

    minimize.Text = minimized and "+" or "—"
end)

--==================================================
-- MOVEMENT CONTROLS
--==================================================

local function updateButton(button, name, enabled)
    if not button then return end

    button.Text = name .. "     [" .. (enabled and "ON" or "OFF") .. "]"
    button.BackgroundColor3 = enabled
        and Color3.fromRGB(36, 57, 88)
        or Color3.fromRGB(30, 35, 48)
end

local hoverButton = makeButton("AUTO HOVER  [OFF]")
local sideButton = makeButton("SIDE TELEPORT  [OFF]")
local equipButton = makeButton("AUTO EQUIP SLOT 1  [OFF]")
local respawnButton = makeButton("AUTO RETURN ON RESPAWN  [OFF]")

local status = makeLabel("STATUS  •  Ready")
status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 30)

hoverButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    if not hoverEnabled then
        if not prepareAnchor() then return end
        hoverEnabled = true
    else
        hoverEnabled = false

        if getRoot() then
            anchorPosition = root.Position
            sideOffset = 0
        end
    end

    updateButton(hoverButton, "AUTO HOVER", hoverEnabled)
end)

sideButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    if not sideEnabled then
        if not anchorPosition then
            if not prepareAnchor() then return end
        end

        sideEnabled = true
        sideOffset = 0
        sideSign = 1
        sideTimer = 0
    else
        sideEnabled = false
        sideOffset = 0
    end

    updateButton(sideButton, "SIDE TELEPORT", sideEnabled)
end)

equipButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    equipEnabled = not equipEnabled
    updateButton(equipButton, "AUTO EQUIP SLOT 1", equipEnabled)
end)

respawnButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    autoReturnEnabled = not autoReturnEnabled

    updateButton(
        respawnButton,
        "AUTO RETURN ON RESPAWN",
        autoReturnEnabled
    )

    status.Text = autoReturnEnabled
        and "STATUS  •  Auto return enabled"
        or "STATUS  •  Auto return disabled"
end)

--==================================================
-- SETTINGS
--==================================================

makeLabel("MOVEMENT SETTINGS")

makeSlider("Hover height (studs)", MIN_HEIGHT, MAX_HEIGHT,
    DEFAULT_HEIGHT, function(v)
        height = v
    end)

makeSlider("Side distance (studs)", MIN_DISTANCE, MAX_DISTANCE,
    DEFAULT_DISTANCE, function(v)
        distance = v
    end)

makeSlider("Side interval (seconds)", MIN_INTERVAL, MAX_INTERVAL,
    DEFAULT_INTERVAL, function(v)
        interval = v
    end)

makeLabel("APPEARANCE")

makeSlider("Panel transparency (%)", 0, 70, 8, function(v)
    panelTransparency = v / 100
    main.BackgroundTransparency = panelTransparency
end)

local accentButton = makeButton("CHANGE ACCENT COLOR")

local accentColors = {
    Color3.fromRGB(85, 145, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(175, 110, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(65, 220, 190),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 135, 160),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 85),
}

local accentIndex = 1

accentButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    accentIndex = accentIndex % #accentColors + 1
    ACCENT = accentColors[accentIndex]

    stroke.Color = ACCENT
    accentButton.TextColor3 = ACCENT
    body.ScrollBarImageColor3 = ACCENT

    for _, obj in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
            obj.Color = ACCENT
        elseif obj:IsA("Frame") and obj.Name == "AccentFill" then
            obj.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
        end
    end
end)

--==================================================
-- RESPAWN HANDLING
--==================================================

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    characterGeneration += 1
    local thisGeneration = characterGeneration

    -- Stop movement using the previous character.
    stopMovement()

    character = char
    humanoid = nil
    root = nil

    status.Text = "STATUS  •  Waiting for character"

    task.spawn(function()
        local newHumanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
        local newRoot = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)

        if thisGeneration ~= characterGeneration then
            return
        end

        if not newHumanoid or not newRoot then
            status.Text = "STATUS  •  Character unavailable"
            return
        end

        humanoid = newHumanoid
        root = newRoot
        backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")

        if autoReturnEnabled and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            -- Use the new spawn point as the anchor.
            anchorPosition = root.Position

            local look = root.CFrame.RightVector
            sideDirection = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)

            if sideDirection.Magnitude < 0.01 then
                sideDirection = Vector3.xAxis
            else
                sideDirection = sideDirection.Unit
            end

            sideOffset = 0
            sideSign = 1
            sideTimer = 0

            -- Resume hovering with the selected height.
            hoverEnabled = true
            sideEnabled = false

            updateButton(hoverButton, "AUTO HOVER", true)
            updateButton(sideButton, "SIDE TELEPORT", false)

            status.Text = "STATUS  •  Returning to sky"
        else
            updateButton(hoverButton, "AUTO HOVER", false)
            updateButton(sideButton, "SIDE TELEPORT", false)

            status.Text = "STATUS  •  Respawned"
        end
    end)
end)

-- Initialize the current character if it already exists.
if player.Character then
    character = player.Character
    humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
end

--==================================================
-- MOVEMENT LOOP
--==================================================

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    if not alive then return end

    if hoverEnabled or sideEnabled then
        if not getRoot() or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            stopMovement()

            updateButton(hoverButton, "AUTO HOVER", false)
            updateButton(sideButton, "SIDE TELEPORT", false)

            status.Text = "STATUS  •  Waiting for character"
            return
        end

        if not anchorPosition then
            if not prepareAnchor() then return end
        end

        if sideEnabled then
            sideTimer += dt

            if sideTimer >= interval then
                sideTimer %= interval
                sideSign = -sideSign
                sideOffset = distance * sideSign
            end
        else
            sideOffset = 0
        end

        local targetPosition =
            anchorPosition
            + Vector3.new(0, hoverEnabled and height or 0, 0)
            + sideDirection * sideOffset

        -- Client-side character positioning.
        local rotation = root.CFrame - root.Position
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPosition) * rotation

        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

        status.Text = "STATUS  •  "
            .. (hoverEnabled and "Hovering" or "Ground mode")
            .. (sideEnabled and " / Side movement" or "")
    end

    -- Automatically equip the first available Tool.
    if equipEnabled then
        equipTimer += dt

        if equipTimer >= 0.25 then
            equipTimer = 0

            if getRoot() and humanoid.Health > 0 and backpack then
                local equippedTool =
                    character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")

                if not equippedTool then
                    for _, item in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
                        if item:IsA("Tool") then
                            pcall(function()
                                humanoid:EquipTool(item)
                            end)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- 冷笑ボット | Roblox Auto Chat

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local OrionLib = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BlizTBr/scripts/main/Orion%20X"))()

-- 指定フレーズ
local PHRASES = {
    "うおw😅",
    "どわー笑😅",
    "ったく…w😅",
    "かっこよw😅",
    "えぐー！笑😅",
    "冗談ですやん！！w🫲😅",
    "きちーww😅🤚",
    "おもろいなあ！ww😅👍",
    "ど、どした？笑😅",
    "ちょw1回落ち着けw落ち着けw😅",
    "ええてw😅🤚",
    "ちょwお前必死やんww😅",
    "すごいなあキミww😅👍", 
    "ちょw怒んなやw😅",
}

local Settings = {
    Enabled = false,
    Interval = 3,      -- 秒
    Random = true,   -- true=ランダム / false=順番
    Index = 1,
}

local function Notify(t, c)
    OrionLib:MakeNotification({Name = t, Content = c, Time = 2})
end

local function SendChat(msg)
    if not msg or msg == "" then return false end

    -- 新チャット (TextChatService)
    local ok = pcall(function()
        if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local channel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if channel then
                channel:SendAsync(msg)
                return
            end
        end
        error("legacy")
    end)

    if ok then return true end

    -- 旧チャット
    local ok2 = pcall(function()
        local events = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
        local say = events and events:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
        if say then
            say:FireServer(msg, "All")
        end
    end)
    return ok2
end

local function NextPhrase()
    if Settings.Random then
        return PHRASES[math.random(1, #PHRASES)]
    end
    local msg = PHRASES[Settings.Index]
    Settings.Index = Settings.Index + 1
    if Settings.Index > #PHRASES then Settings.Index = 1 end
    return msg
end

local botTask
local function StartBot()
    if botTask then return end
    Settings.Enabled = true
    Notify("冷笑ボット", "開始")
    botTask = task.spawn(function()
        while Settings.Enabled do
            local msg = NextPhrase()
            SendChat(msg)
            task.wait(Settings.Interval)
        end
        botTask = nil
    end)
end

local function StopBot()
    Settings.Enabled = false
    if botTask then
        pcall(function() task.cancel(botTask) end)
        botTask = nil
    end
    Notify("冷笑ボット", "停止")
end

-- UI

    Name = "冷笑ボット",
    HidePremium = false,
    SaveConfig = false,
    ConfigFolder = "reisyou_bot"
})

Tab:AddParagraph("フレーズ", #PHRASES .. " 個登録済み")

Tab:AddToggle({

    Default = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        if v then StartBot() else StopBot() end
    end
})

Tab:AddToggle({
    Name = "ランダム送信",
    Default = true,
    Callback = function(v) Settings.Random = v end
})

Tab:AddSlider({
    Name = "間隔（秒）",
    Min = 1,
    Max = 15,
    Default = 3,
    Increment = 1,
    Callback = function(v) Settings.Interval = v end
})

Tab:AddButton({
    Name = "今すぐ1回送る",
    Callback = function()
        local msg = NextPhrase()
        SendChat(msg)
        Notify("送信", msg)
    end
})

Tab:AddButton({
    Name = "全部順番に1周送る",
    Callback = function()
        task.spawn(function()
            for _, msg in ipairs(PHRASES) do
                if not Settings.Enabled and false then break end
                SendChat(msg)
                task.wait(math.max(Settings.Interval, 1.5))
            end
            Notify("冷笑ボット", "1周完了")
        end)
    end
})

OrionLib:MakeNotification({
    Name = "冷笑ボット",
    Content = "準備完了",
    Time = 3
})

-- Cherry's Club | The Nightmare Locust (V22 - Smooth & Reactive)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local MODEL_ID = "85434241672934" 
local currentModel = nil
local rootPart = nil
local bones = {}
local walkPhase = 0
local twitchPhase = 0
local breathPhase = 0
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()

-- ============================================================
-- AUDIO
-- ============================================================
local AUDIO_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/michineitorxd3000-coder/idk-bro-locust/main/Locustadiotrack.mp3.mp3"
local FOLDER_NAME = "LocustAudio"
local FILE_NAME = "Locustadiotrack.mp3"
local FILE_PATH = FOLDER_NAME .. "/" .. FILE_NAME

local function setupAudio()
    if not writefile or not isfolder or not isfile or not getcustomasset then return "rbxassetid://131961136" end
    if not isfolder(FOLDER_NAME) then makefolder(FOLDER_NAME) end
    if not isfile(FILE_PATH) then
        local success, response = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(AUDIO_URL) end)
        if success and response then writefile(FILE_PATH, response) else return "rbxassetid://131961136" end
    end
    local assetSuccess, assetId = pcall(function() return getcustomasset(FILE_PATH) end)
    return assetSuccess and assetId or "rbxassetid://131961136"
end

local customSoundId = setupAudio()
local screechSound = Instance.new("Sound")
screechSound.SoundId = customSoundId
screechSound.Volume = 3 
screechSound.Pitch = 0.8 
screechSound.RollOffMaxDistance = 120
screechSound.Parent = SoundService

local function playScreech()
    if not screechSound.IsPlaying then
        task.delay(math.random(0, 50) / 100, function() if not screechSound.IsPlaying then screechSound:Play() end end)
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- SPAWN (True Morph)
-- ============================================================
local function spawnModel()
    if currentModel then currentModel:Destroy(); currentModel = nil end
    bones = {}
    
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end

    local animateScript = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if animateScript then animateScript:Destroy() end
    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if animator then for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do track:Stop() end end

    -- Ocultar y destruir accesorios
    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:IsA("Accessory") or obj:IsA("Shirt") or obj:IsA("Pants") or obj:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
            obj:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local success, model = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. MODEL_ID)[1] end)
    if not success or not model then return end

    for _, obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            obj.Anchored = true
            obj.CanCollide = false
        elseif obj:IsA("Script") or obj:IsA("LocalScript") then
            obj:Destroy()
        end
    end

    model.Name = "NightmareLocust"
    model.Parent = workspace
    currentModel = model
    model:ScaleTo(0.05) 

    rootPart = model:FindFirstChild("RootPart", true) or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if not rootPart then return end
    model.PrimaryPart = rootPart

    for _, obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Bone") then
            bones[obj.Name] = { bone = obj, restCFrame = obj.CFrame }
        end
    end

    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, currentModel }
    rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    playScreech()
end

-- ============================================================
-- LOOP PRINCIPAL
-- ============================================================
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not currentModel or not rootPart then return end
    
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end

    -- Invisibilidad
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            part.Transparency = 1
            part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
        end
    end

    local speed = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude * hum.WalkSpeed
    local moving = speed > 0.1
    
    -- Variables de reacción
    local lightReaction = 0
    local isScaredOfLight = false

    if moving then
        walkPhase = walkPhase + dt * (speed * 0.25) -- Más lento = más fluido
        twitchPhase = twitchPhase + dt * 15
        breathPhase = breathPhase + dt * 4
        if math.random() > 0.98 then playScreech() end
    else
        walkPhase = 0
        breathPhase = breathPhase + dt * 1.5
        twitchPhase = twitchPhase + dt * (math.random() > 0.9 and 20 or 2)
        if math.random() > 0.995 then playScreech() end
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- REACCIÓN A LA LUZ (Si hay una linterna cerca, se asusta)
    -- ============================================================
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("SpotLight") or obj:IsA("PointLight") then
            if obj.Enabled and obj.Brightness > 1 then
                local dist = (obj.Parent.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < 25 then -- Si la luz está a menos de 25 studs
                    isScaredOfLight = true
                    lightReaction = math.clamp(1 - (dist / 25), 0, 1) -- Más cerca = más reacción
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if isScaredOfLight and math.random() > 0.9 then
        playScreech() -- Chilla si le da la luz
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- MATEMÁTICAS DE SUELO (Sin rotar hacia adelante)
    -- ============================================================
    local baseOffset = -3.0 -- Subimos un poco el cuerpo para que no toque el suelo
    local rayOrigin = hrp.Position
    local floorHit = workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin, Vector3.new(0, -10, 0), rayParams)
    
    if floorHit then
        local distanceToFloor = (hrp.Position.Y - floorHit.Position.Y)
        baseOffset = -distanceToFloor + 0.5 
    end

    local ceilingRay = workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), rayParams)
    if ceilingRay then baseOffset = baseOffset - 0.5 end

    -- SWAY (Balanceo natural del cuerpo)
    local sway = moving and math.sin(walkPhase) * math.rad(3) or 0
    local bob = moving and ((math.sin(walkPhase * 2) * 0.2) - 0.2) or 0

    rootPart.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, baseOffset + bob, 0)

    local function applyBone(name, rotOffset)
        local bData = bones[name]
        if bData then bData.bone.CFrame = bData.restCFrame * rotOffset end
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- POSTURA (Menos inclinado, más fluido)
    -- ============================================================
    local breath = math.sin(breathPhase) * math.rad(2)
    
    -- Si tiene miedo a la luz, se echa hacia atrás. Si no, camina normal.
    local huntPose = 0
    if isScaredOfLight then
        huntPose = math.rad(15) * lightReaction -- Se arquea hacia atrás
    else
        huntPose = moving and math.rad(-15) or math.rad(-5) -- Menos inclinado
    end
    
    -- Aplicamos Sway a la columna
    applyBone("spine", CFrame.Angles(huntPose + sway + breath, 0, 0))
    applyBone("spine.001", CFrame.Angles(sway + breath, 0, 0))
    applyBone("spine.002", CFrame.Angles(sway, 0, 0))
    
    -- Joroba suave
    local hunch = isScaredOfLight and math.rad(5) or math.rad(-10)
    applyBone("spine.003", CFrame.Angles(hunch + breath, 0, 0))
    applyBone("spine.004", CFrame.Angles(hunch, 0, 0))
    applyBone("spine.005", CFrame.Angles(hunch, 0, 0))

    -- CABEZA (Mira a los lados suavemente)
    local headTwitch = math.sin(twitchPhase * 1.5) * math.rad(8)
    local neckTwitch = math.cos(twitchPhase * 0.8) * math.rad(4)
    applyBone("spine.006", CFrame.Angles(hunch + neckTwitch, headTwitch, 0))

    -- ============================================================
    -- PIERNAS (Animación de paso suave, sin rigidez)
    -- ============================================================
    if moving then
        local function getLegRotations(phase)
            -- Usamos una onda senoidal más suave
            local s = math.sin(phase)
            local c = math.cos(phase)
            
            -- Pasos más largos y suaves
            local thighRotX = s * math.rad(45)
            -- La rodilla se dobla suavemente
            local kneeRotX = (s > 0) and -(s * math.rad(60)) or -math.rad(15)
            
            -- Un pequeño balanceo lateral en la cadera (Sway de piernas)
            local thighRotZ = c * math.rad(5)

            return CFrame.Angles(thighRotX, 0, thighRotZ), CFrame.Angles(kneeRotX, 0, 0)
        end

        local rThigh, rKnee = getLegRotations(walkPhase)
        local lThigh, lKnee = getLegRotations(walkPhase + math.pi)

        applyBone("thigh.R", rThigh)
        applyBone("thigh.L", lThigh)
        applyBone("shin.R", rKnee)
        applyBone("shin.L", lKnee)

        local function getFootAngle(phase)
            local s = math.sin(phase)
            return CFrame.Angles(s * math.rad(20), 0, 0)
        end
        applyBone("foot.R", getFootAngle(walkPhase))
        applyBone("foot.L", getFootAngle(walkPhase + math.pi))
    else
        -- Quieto (Respirando y con miedo a la luz)
        local idleThigh = isScaredOfLight and math.rad(10) or math.rad(20)
        applyBone("thigh.R", CFrame.Angles(idleThigh, 0, 0))
        applyBone("thigh.L", CFrame.Angles(idleThigh, 0, 0))
        applyBone("shin.R", CFrame.Angles(-math.rad(30), 0, 0))
        applyBone("shin.L", CFrame.Angles(-math.rad(30), 0, 0))
        applyBone("foot.R", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(10), 0, 0))
        applyBone("foot.L", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(10), 0, 0))
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- BRAZOS (Fluidos y con Raycast)
    -- ============================================================
    local armSwing = moving and math.sin(walkPhase + math.pi) * math.rad(15) or 0
    local tremble = math.sin(twitchPhase) * math.rad(1.5)
    
    -- Si tiene miedo a la luz, se cubre la cara con los brazos
    local coverFace = isScaredOfLight and math.rad(90) * lightReaction or 0

    local armL = CFrame.Angles(armSwing + tremble + math.rad(5) + coverFace, 0, math.rad(5))
    local armR = CFrame.Angles(-armSwing - tremble + math.rad(5) + coverFace, 0, math.rad(-5))

    local shoulderR = bones["shoulder.R"] and bones["shoulder.R"].bone.WorldPosition
    local shoulderL = bones["shoulder.L"] and bones["shoulder.L"].bone.WorldPosition

    if shoulderR then
        local hitR = workspace:Raycast(shoulderR, rootPart.CFrame.RightVector * 8, rayParams)
        if hitR then
            local lookDir = (hitR.Position - shoulderR).Unit
            armR = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0,0,0), lookDir) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
        end
    end
    if shoulderL then
        local hitL = workspace:Raycast(shoulderL, -rootPart.CFrame.RightVector * 8, rayParams)
        if hitL then
            local lookDir = (hitL.Position - shoulderL).Unit
            armL = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0,0,0), lookDir) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
        end
    end

    applyBone("upper_arm.R", armR)
    applyBone("upper_arm.L", armL)
end)
